newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Hang Seng Index rockets into record ground.
newsitem.headline: HK's Hang Seng Index rockets into record ground.

text.p: Hong Kong's blue chip Hang Seng Index powered into record territory on Friday, surging 520 points, or 3.59 percent, to 15,026 ahead of the midsession close.
Shares in Hang Seng Bank led the rally as it also steamed into uncharted territory, gaining HK$10.75 to HK$107.50 on talk that a Chinese company could buy a stake in the bank.
"Hang Seng Bank is leading the banking sector up, properties are rising and red chips are surging. The overall market is strong," said Antony Mak, sales director at Vickers Ballas.
"The rally should extend into the handover next week due to handover fever," he added.
Hong Kong returns to Chinese rule at midnight of June 30 after 156 years of colonial rule.
